title: Honor Cantrip embedded workbench presentations
reason: Explorer popouts and the global Code customization surface transition an already-running OpenVSCode workbench into restricted presentations. The extension API cannot inspect or authoritatively constrain runtime workbench-part visibility or future notification toasts, and OpenVSCode restores persisted workbench chrome before the remote extension activates. This patch makes the per-workspace cantrip.presentation setting authoritative: editor embeds hide all non-editor chrome and toasts, while Extensions embeds retain only the primary sidebar, editor details, and required notifications or dialogs.
validation: Open a file from Explorer in the desktop popout and confirm the title, Activity Bar, both sidebars, panel, status bar, editor tab strip, minimap, and notification toasts are absent
Open the Extensions customization surface and confirm only the primary sidebar, extension details editor, and required notifications or dialogs are available
removal: Remove if OpenVSCode exposes a window-local extension API for authoritatively constraining every embedded workbench part and notification toast, or if Cantrip stops embedding restricted Code surfaces.
